# 99.00 USD bought for 135.00 CAD, in a transaction stated in USD, beside a CAD
# fee line whose value of 1.00 USD has no CAD amount behind it.
#
# In a transaction stated in a foreign currency the rate comes from the CAD
# splits: their CAD amounts added up, over the USD values they are worth. The
# bank's 135.00 CAD is worth 100.00 USD, which is 1.35. The fee line holds no
# CAD, so it says nothing about the rate, and counted it would put 101.00 USD
# under the same 135.00 CAD and price the purchase at 1.3366.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Bank Fees
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 99 USD for 135 CAD, stated in USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 99.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "99.00"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		value: "-100.00"
	Expenses:Bank Fees 0.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		value: "1.00"
